fields.quote: Full evaluations on all 16 NLP tasks, with comparisons to the GPT-3 reported performance.
fields.reason: NR is unsupported: the caption explicitly compares against GPT-3's reported (previously published) performance, i.e. scores taken from another report. MIXED is not supported on these pages because nothing states that any comparator was re-scored by the authors; the available wording only documents use of reported comparator numbers.

Page 1 gives hardware count (992 80GB A100 GPUs) and per-GPU throughput (147 TFLOP/s) plus a 1/7th carbon ratio, but not GPU/TPU-hours, total FLOPs, or hardware times duration. That does not meet the field definition, so the lower value N is correct.
